corrective_rotation.about: grip contact (SKILL: 装配矩阵绕握把接触点反向旋该角度)

pca_measurement.method: principal axes of the vertex cloud (shape-independent)
pca_measurement.note: the area-weighted top-normal figure (3.04 deg) is biased: the SVD carries ~4x the top-facing area of the M4 (sloped wooden handguard and cheek piece), while its flat top band measures exactly 0.000 deg

decision: reverted: PCA puts the aligned SVD within 0.66 deg of the M4, below the M4 own aim/idle spread (0.03/0.37), so baking a 3.04 deg counter-rotation would have introduced the very cant it was meant to remove. Re-apply only on visual confirmation.
